title: Database Admin / Service-Role Key Exposed in Client Asset
description: An administrative master key (SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) that bypasses all security rules was included in files sent directly to web browsers.
code_snippet:
const SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = "VPL_FAKE_service_role_client_key_998877";
const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SERVICE_ROLE_KEY);

title: SQL Injection via Raw String Interpolation in Query Builder
description: Direct concatenation of untrusted client parameters into a raw SQL query string allows attackers to inject arbitrary SQL statements, bypass authentication, or exfiltrate database contents.
code_snippet:
const query = `SELECT * FROM student_records WHERE student_id = '${req.params.id}' AND semester = '${req.query.semester}'`;
const records = await db.raw(query);
cwe: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command

title: Unhandled Promise Rejection & Missing Exception Boundary in Async Handler
description: Asynchronous controller function lacks try-catch wrapping or express-async-errors middleware. Any rejected database or third-party promise causes an unhandled promise rejection that can crash the worker process.
cwe: CWE-755: Improper Handling of Exceptional Conditions

title: Prototype Pollution via Unsafe Recursive Object Merge
description: Custom deep object merge implementation fails to block sensitive prototype properties such as '__proto__', 'constructor', and 'prototype', enabling attackers to inject rogue properties into the global Object prototype.
cwe: CWE-1321: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes

title: Path Traversal via Unsanitized File Stream Path Concatenation
description: The application constructs an absolute file path using untrusted query input without validating that the canonical path stays confined to the designated export directory, allowing arbitrary file retrieval.
code_snippet:
const filePath = path.join(EXPORT_DIR, req.query.reportFile as string);
fs.createReadStream(filePath).pipe(res);
cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

title: Race Condition in Financial Transfer (Non-Atomic Check-Then-Act)
description: Account balance verification and deduction are executed as separate, non-atomic database queries without row locking or serializable transactions, allowing concurrent requests to trigger double-spending.
cwe: CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization

title: Dockerfile Without Dedicated USER Instruction
description: Container process executes with unrestricted root privileges without defining a dedicated non-root USER instruction.
code_snippet:
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm install
CMD ["npm", "start"]

title: Hardcoded API Key / Secret Literal
description: Live commercial payment gateway credentials detected directly in source code assets.
code_snippet:
const STRIPE_SECRET = "VPL_FAKE_sk_live_94819482918471928471";
const stripe = new Stripe(STRIPE_SECRET, { apiVersion: '2023-10-16' });

title: Missing Closing Parenthesis / Syntax Error
description: SyntaxError: Unexpected token '{'. The conditional statement is missing a closing parenthesis, causing a fatal parsing error that prevents execution.
cwe: CWE-398: Indicator of Poor Code Quality

title: Uncaught TypeError / Null Pointer Dereference
description: Attempting to call a method on an object that can be None without prior null-checking, leading to a runtime application crash.
code_snippet:
user_record = fetch_user_from_db(user_id)
# Crashes with AttributeError if user_record is None
user_email = user_record.get('email')
return send_welcome_email(user_email)

title: Missing Comma / JSON Parse Error
description: SyntaxError: Expected a comma or closing brace. The missing comma between key-value pairs will cause the application to crash upon startup when parsing the configuration file.

title: ArrayIndexOutOfBounds / Off-by-One Error
description: The loop iterates up to and including the length of the array using '<=', which will inevitably throw an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException during runtime on the final iteration.

title: Missing Semicolon / Compilation Error
description: Syntax error: missing ';' before identifier 'return'. This violates C++ syntax rules and prevents the source file from successfully compiling in the CI/CD pipeline.
cwe: CWE-398: Indicator of Poor Code Quality

title: Missing Resource Cleanup / Database Connection Leak
description: Failing to close database rows after a query execution. This prevents the connection from returning to the pool, leading to resource exhaustion and eventual application hangs under load.
cwe: CWE-404: Improper Resource Shutdown or Release

title: Unhandled Promise Rejection / Missing Error Boundary
description: An asynchronous network call is awaited without a try/catch block. If the third-party API fails or times out, the unhandled rejection will crash the Node.js process.
cwe: CWE-754: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions

title: Thread-Unsafe Collection Modification / Race Condition
description: Modifying a standard generic Dictionary from multiple threads simultaneously. This causes race conditions that corrupt the dictionary's internal state, resulting in infinite loops or application crashes.
cwe: CWE-362: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition')

title: Mutable Default Argument / State Leak
description: Using a mutable object (like a list or dictionary) as a default argument. The object is evaluated only once when the function is defined, causing unintended state persistence and data leaking across multiple independent function calls.

title: Unconditional State Update in useEffect / Infinite Loop
description: Updating state directly inside a useEffect hook without a dependency array or termination condition. This triggers a component re-render, which immediately re-runs the effect, creating an infinite render loop that will freeze or crash the browser tab.
cwe: CWE-835: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')

title: Memory Leak / Unfreed Allocated Memory
description: Memory dynamically allocated using malloc is not freed before the function returns on an error path. This leads to a memory leak that can gradually exhaust system memory and crash the application.
cwe: CWE-401: Missing Release of Memory after Effective Lifetime
